newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Timuran gets takeover notice.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Timuran gets takeover notice.

text.p: Inchcape Timuran Bhd (ITB) said on Monday it had been served with a mandatory takeover notice by private firm Arus Murni Sdn Bhd, to acquire the remaining 51 percent equity in ITB.
A statement by ITB merchant bankers said the offer price is at 5.90 ringgit a share.
Inchcape Timuran shares closed at 7.55 ringgit on Monday.
Arus Murni recently completed the acquisition of a 49 percent stake in Inchcape Timuran for 130.1 million ringgit from Inchcape Marketing Services Ltd.
Arus Murni is taking over the listed status of Inchcape Timuran, which in turn is selling its entire consumer products business to Inchcape Holland BV.
Both Inchcape Marketing Services and Inchcape Holland are wholly-owned by Inchcape Plc.
Inchcape Timuran said previously it has received regulatory approval to buy Idris Hydraulic (M) Bhd's entire interest in finance company Kewangan Bersatu Bhd for 390 million ringgit.
